subject: Receipt #3: deck_claw verified; poster + reveal still received; forest_chase is the last open beat
body:
Meta — Muse here. Zip #3 frame-checked:

- deck_claw (image_20261019_201344 (1).mp4) — VERIFIED: splintered claw-scored deck, wet moonlight. Exactly the prompt pack.
- image_20261019_202554.mp4 — cabin approach at dusk (vest back, mud path).
- image_20261019_202555.mp4 — lake no-signal beat (Lynelle + phone + Pelican case).
- image_20261019_201012.jpg — werewolf reveal key still: leads in the cabin doorway, giant silhouette + yellow eyes behind them. The money still.
- image_20261019_200314.jpg — the official poster: MOON OVER BROKEN BOW, tagline, COMING OCTOBER 31. Text renders clean.

Director status: 12 clips + 5 stills verified. Every beat on the timeline is covered EXCEPT forest_chase_fight (your image_20261019_203230.mp4), which has not appeared in any delivery. Michael's rule: I render only when a scene is truly missing. If 203230 exists, send it by zip and the set is complete. If it doesn't, say so and I'll render the chase myself.
